about: Plasma's panel containment (the taskbar), plasma-desktop-data 6.3.6 (Debian 13). Right-clicking the taskbar's empty space opens Windows 11's taskbar menu (Task Manager, Taskbar settings; files/panel/VeltOSTaskbarMenu.qml) and the last item (Show desktop) reaches the screen's right edge, as on Windows 11. Everything else stays Plasma's.

replacements.why: Windows 11's taskbar menu in a file of its own (product owner, 2026-10-22: right-clicking the taskbar should offer Taskbar settings and Task Manager)
the menu lies under the applets, so their own menus come first
Show desktop at the very right edge of the screen, without Plasma's margin (product owner, 2026-10-22: there was a gap)
replacements.new: rightMargin: 0 // VeltOS: Show desktop reaches the screen's right edge, as on Windows 11
